meta.description: Michal Lipka – software developer of web, system and mobile applications and infrastructure engineer. PHP, TypeScript, Python, Java, Next.js, Laravel, Expo, Docker, Kubernetes.

hero.role: Software developer of web, system and mobile applications and infrastructure engineer.
hero.lead: I design, build and operate software solutions together with the infrastructure they run on – from database design through backend and frontend to servers, deployment and ongoing maintenance.
hero.sketchAlt: Hand-drawn diagram: a web app and a mobile app send data to a server, which stores it in a database.

about.title: About
about.text1: I am a software developer and infrastructure engineer based in the Czech Republic. Since {year} I have been professionally designing and building web, system and mobile applications.
about.text2: I bridge development and infrastructure. Beyond the application itself, I design the environment it runs in – servers, virtualization, databases, deployment and operations. Clients work with one person who understands the entire system.

facts.years: {count, plural, one {# year} other {# years}} of experience
facts.focusValue: Web, system and mobile applications, infrastructure

web.name: Web applications
web.text: Custom web applications, internal systems and APIs. Laravel on the backend, Next.js and TypeScript on the frontend – with an emphasis on a well-designed data model, performance and long-term maintainability.

systems.name: System applications
systems.text: Backend services and background tools – data processing, process automation and integrations between systems.

mobile.name: Mobile applications
mobile.text: Mobile applications for iOS and Android from a single codebase in Expo (React Native), connected to a dedicated backend and API.
points: App Store and Google Play releases

infrastructure.name: Infrastructure
infrastructure.text: Design, build-out and operation of the infrastructure applications run on – servers and virtualization, containers, networking and databases.

items.title: RobStark

items.title: Batlify
